settings.open_command.label: Open command
settings.open_command.description: Command launched when the widget is clicked (default: pika-backup).
settings.repository.label: Borg repository
settings.repository.description: Repository queried with borg list. Leave blank to show Backup not configured.
settings.mount_path.label: Required disk path
settings.mount_path.description: Optional. A directory that must exist before the repository is checked; use this for removable backup disks.
settings.max_age_hours.label: Maximum backup age (hours)
settings.max_age_hours.description: A successful archive older than this is shown as Backup failed. The default is eight days, suitable for a weekly backup.
